note: Reusable alpha structures. Each entry is a formula with slots, plus the measured evidence that justifies keeping it. Expand with tools/templates.py.

templates.name: Within-group short/long mean ratio
templates.evidence: Best general shape here: web engagement 1.71, hiring 2.15, vendor model 1.77. Grouping matters for production correlation, not only for Sharpe: across 10 measured alphas, sector-grouped arms averaged PC 0.768 (0.572-0.893) while subindustry-grouped averaged 0.880 (0.783-0.957); the only PC pass was sector + ratio (0.572). Prefer sector first when PC is the binding constraint.

templates.name: Within-group level rank
templates.evidence: Works on prediction fields (vendor 20d quantile 1.77), fails on most fundamentals. Watch turnover: level of a fast field breaches 70%. Production correlation measured on four level arms: 0.783-0.957, all above the 0.70 line, and all subindustry-grouped.

templates.name: Short-term level orthogonal to own long-term norm, neutral within country
templates.evidence: GLB ATOM template from BRAIN Tips 001 (ts_median is not available on this account; ts_mean substitutes). First GLB tests: model110 score 0.79, analyst15 1m change 0.09.

templates.name: Own-history rank, then group rank
templates.evidence: Template #1 from Machine Alpha basics. Beat the level form on valuation_model_suite_7 (2.48 vs 1.96) but production correlation stayed 0.81.

templates.name: Profitability relative to size, time-series operator
templates.evidence: Machine Alpha basics #2. Not yet measured here; two fields means it cannot be ATOM.

templates.name: Net sentiment, ranked after backfill, time-series operator
templates.evidence: Machine Alpha basics #3. Sentiment family measured dead in this account (0.03-0.86 across news/forum/social), so this is kept only as a documented shape.

templates.name: Raw change over a window
templates.evidence: Tested on valuation_model_suite_7: 2.29 Sharpe but sub-universe FAIL and high turnover. Delta on rank-like inputs is mostly noise.

templates.name: Enter on an event, hold a fixed window
templates.evidence: Built and falsified on earnings4 (7 arms, all <=0.10). Kept because the shape is the only way to express event timing; needs an event field that actually carries drift.

templates.name: Per-topic net sentiment (positive minus negative)
templates.evidence: Strongest family found 2026-11-19. On earningscall_sentiment (5 topics, coverage 0.86) it produced five zero-FAIL candidates, all robust year by year: profitability trend 1.70 (worst year +0.59, last3 2.12), leverage net 1.67 (+0.24, 2.12, fitness 1.08), profitability net 1.61 (+0.21, 1.95), cashflow net 1.53 (+0.32, 1.91), valuation net 1.35 (+0.07, 1.58). Turnover stays near 3% and sub-universe clears its bar by 1.2-1.35x, which matters because that bar scales with Sharpe. Two fields means the alpha is not ATOM-shaped. The five are one mechanism (same transcript, different topic), so count them once.

shape_statistics.note: clean = no stored FAIL, turnover 1-70%, Sharpe >= 1.0
shape_statistics.reading: ratio_trend has the most total output only because it was tried most often; per-arm the net-sentiment difference shape is three times more likely to clear the bars. The orthogonal form (short vs long term neutralised) has produced nothing clean in four tries.

combination_logic.rule: pick the logic from the relationship between channels; the same pair inverted by the wrong logic

cases.pair: conference-call profitability tone x analyst revision horizon
cases.reading: complementary channels: agreement is the signal, disagreement carries the opposite sign

failures.why: multiplying two ranks from the same dataset compresses the distribution; the operands were never independent

practice: rank each leg inside the same group so they share a scale before combining
check the two legs' mutual correlation first: near zero means blend, high means one leg is redundant
